questions.question: What is the primary power source for modern AI?
questions.explanation: AI models learn patterns from massive amounts of data.

questions.question: Which of these best describes an AI algorithm?
options: A set of rules or instructions
questions.explanation: Algorithms are the mathematical recipes AI follows.

questions.question: What happens during the 'Training' phase of Machine Learning?
options: The computer goes to the gym
The model learns patterns from data
questions.explanation: Training is when the model adjusts itself to match the examples provided.
